contracts.id: DJ Table: Left Deck (Deck A)->DJ Table: Central Mixer Console
contracts.payload: { playing: boolean; level: [number, number] /* [left, right] pre-mixer signal level, each 0-1 */ }

contracts.id: DJ Table: Right Deck (Deck B)->DJ Table: Central Mixer Console
contracts.payload: { playing: boolean; level: [number, number] /* [left, right] pre-mixer signal level, each 0-1 */ }

contracts.id: DJ Table: Effects Rack->DJ Table: Central Mixer Console
contracts.payload: { on: boolean /* FX engaged; when false the mixer applies no processing */; channel: 'a' | 'b' | 'm' /* target: channel A, channel B, or master */; type: 'echo' | 'reverb' | 'filter' | 'flanger' | 'gate'; wet: number /* wet/dry mix, 0-100 */; params: [number, number, number] /* three effect params, each 0-100 */; division: '1/8' | '1/4' | '1/2' | '1' | '2' | '4' /* beat division */ }

contracts.id: DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display->DJ Table: Right Deck (Deck B)
contracts.payload: { time: number /* seek target in seconds from track start */ }

contracts.id: DJ Table: Track Library Browser->DJ Table: Right Deck (Deck B)
contracts.payload: { title: string; artist: string; bpm: number /* beats per minute */; key: string /* Camelot key, e.g. '8A' */; duration: number /* track length in seconds */; cuePoint: number /* initial playhead position in seconds */; waveform: number[] /* amplitude samples, each 0-1 */ }

contracts.id: DJ Table: Left Deck (Deck A)->DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display
contracts.payload: { time: number /* playhead position in seconds */; duration: number /* total track length in seconds */; playing: boolean; bpm: number /* effective tempo after pitch, beats/min */ }

contracts.id: DJ Table: Right Deck (Deck B)->DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display
contracts.payload: { time: number /* playhead position in seconds */; duration: number /* total track length in seconds */; playing: boolean; bpm: number /* effective tempo after pitch, beats/min */ }

contracts.id: DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display->DJ Table: Left Deck (Deck A)
contracts.payload: { time: number /* seek target in seconds */ }

contracts.id: DJ Table: Track Library Browser->DJ Table: Left Deck (Deck A)
contracts.payload: { id: string; title: string; artist: string; bpm: number /* track base tempo, beats/min */; key: string /* Camelot key, e.g. '8A' */; duration: number /* seconds */ }

contracts.id: DJ Table: Central Mixer Console->DJ Table: Master Output & VU Meters
contracts.payload: { levels: [number, number] /* post-crossfader L,R, each 0-1 */; peak: [number, number] /* L,R peak hold, each 0-1 */ }

channelList.id: DJ Table: Left Deck (Deck A)->DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display
channelList.description: On every playback tick and on play/pause/cue/pitch changes, this deck emits its current playhead position, play state, and effective tempo so the display continuously scrolls and renders Deck A's waveform lane and beat grid.

channelList.id: DJ Table: Left Deck (Deck A)->DJ Table: Central Mixer Console
channelList.description: This deck streams its live output signal level and play state into the mixer's channel A input, driving channel A's VU meter and providing the source that channel A's fader, EQ, gain, and the crossfader then process.

channelList.id: DJ Table: Right Deck (Deck B)->DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display
channelList.description: On every playback tick and on play/pause/cue/pitch changes, this deck emits its current playhead position, play state, and effective tempo so the display continuously scrolls and renders Deck B's waveform lane and beat grid.

channelList.id: DJ Table: Right Deck (Deck B)->DJ Table: Central Mixer Console
channelList.description: This deck streams its live output signal level and play state into the mixer's channel B input, driving channel B's VU meter and providing the source that channel B's fader, EQ, gain, and the crossfader then process.

channelList.id: DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display->DJ Table: Left Deck (Deck A)
channelList.description: When the user clicks or drags within the top (Deck A) lane, the display computes the corresponding track time and emits a seek command that repositions Deck A's playhead.

channelList.id: DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display->DJ Table: Right Deck (Deck B)
channelList.description: When the user clicks or drags within the bottom (Deck B) lane, the display computes the corresponding track time and emits a seek command that repositions Deck B's playhead.

channelList.id: DJ Table: Central Mixer Console->DJ Table: Master Output & VU Meters
channelList.to: DJ Table: Master Output & VU Meters
channelList.description: The final post-crossfader mixed stereo signal and its combined level are sent to the master section, driving the master VU meters and being scaled by the master/booth volume before final output and recording.

channelList.id: DJ Table: Effects Rack->DJ Table: Central Mixer Console
channelList.description: The channel routing selector chooses which mixer channel (A or B) the effect inserts on; while the FX on/off toggle is engaged, the rack emits the selected effect type, wet/dry ratio, parameter values, and beat division, and the mixer applies this processing to that channel's signal before the crossfader and master mix.

channelList.id: DJ Table: Track Library Browser->DJ Table: Left Deck (Deck A)
channelList.description: When the user selects a row and clicks 'Load to Deck A', the browser sends that track's metadata, audio buffer, BPM, and waveform data to Deck A, which loads it fresh at the cue point.

channelList.id: DJ Table: Track Library Browser->DJ Table: Right Deck (Deck B)
channelList.description: When the user selects a row and clicks 'Load to Deck B', the browser sends that track's metadata, audio buffer, BPM, and waveform data to Deck B, which loads it fresh at the cue point.
